---
title: "n vs B exploration"
format: html
---
```{r}
set.seed(5405)  
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

hist(replicate(200,   mean(rexp(5))),  breaks = 30, main = "n = 5, B = 200")
hist(replicate(10000, mean(rexp(5))),  breaks = 30, main = "n = 5, B = 10000")
hist(replicate(200,   mean(rexp(50))), breaks = 30, main = "n = 50, B = 200")
hist(replicate(10000, mean(rexp(50))), breaks = 30, main = "n = 50, B = 10000")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
